Class ChatShell

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.ChatShell
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectErrorStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectInputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectOutputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectStreamsAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle, CommandContext
public class ChatShell extends Object implements org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, Runnable, CommandContext
The ChatShell class is the VT100 shell for one SSH connection. It implements Command, Runnable, and CommandContext. It holds the line buffer, the escape mode, and the chat session. Command echo is green. Enter goes to the command processor or the model worker. The shell does not name the commands. Terminal bytes stay on this connection.
Author:
clayl (2026-08-24)

  • Constructor Details

    • ChatShell

      public ChatShell(ChatSession session, CommandProcessor processor, LlmService llmService, CasseroleProperties properties, String modelName, FormatRouter formatRouter, Lamina lamina, LlmRouter llmRouter, AmwpFacade amwpFacade)
      The constructor stores the session, the command processor, and the model services. Think starts empty. The family starts as ollama. Effort sending starts on. Stream starts off. Temperature starts at 1.0 and is not sent. The max-token value starts at 128000 and is not sent. The pool boot is a new random id. The mode starts as chat. The terminal width starts at 80. The escape timer is a daemon named casserole-esc. The spinner timer is a daemon named casserole-spinner.
      Parameters:
      session - The session is the chat state for this connection.
      processor - The processor is the command registry for this connection.
      llmService - The service is the Ollama boundary stored for this shell.
      properties - The properties are the server settings.
      modelName - The model name is the configured Ollama id used for status.
      formatRouter - The router formats a reply before it is written.
      lamina - The lamina submits the read loop and the model turn.
      llmRouter - The router is the provider map. The console turn calls AmwpFacade.completeTurn(String, AmwpToon.ExecuteBody, List) and does not take the execute permit.
      amwpFacade - The facade runs a console turn and a framed turn on the same path.

    • start

      public void start(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel, org.apache.sshd.server.Environment env) throws IOException
      The start method prepares the connection and submits the read loop. The SSH user name is read from the server session. A failure stores an empty name. The terminal width comes from parseColumns(Environment). Window-change listening starts. History and the console model are loaded. Bracketed paste is enabled. The welcome text is Welcome to Casserole chat, then the type, escape, Ctrl+C, and exit lines, then the paste line. A restored session writes the restored count and the user name. Any other session writes New session. The prompt is written. The read task is named casserole-chat-shell on Lane.SSH_IO.
      Specified by:
      start in interface org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel for this shell.
      env - The environment carries the terminal columns.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method declares this exception when a write fails.

    • destroy

      public void destroy(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel)
      The destroy method closes this shell. The exit flag is set. A paste is cleared. The in-flight turn is cancelled. Bracketed paste is disabled. The session is closed. The spinner and the escape timer are stopped and cancelled. The read task is cancelled.
      Specified by:
      destroy in interface org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel being closed.

    • run

      public void run()
      The run method reads SSH input until the stream ends or the shell exits. Each read uses a 1024 character buffer. Characters are handled under the shell lock, and one paint is flushed after the buffer. A clean end calls the exit callback with status 0. Any other failure calls it with status 1 and the exception message. An exit that is already underway does not call the callback.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • applyConsoleModel

      public void applyConsoleModel(String model, String think)
      The applyConsoleModel method stores the console model and the think string. The family becomes ollama. An empty model leaves the current name. An empty think string clears think. A turn already inside the completion keeps the values it already read.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the Ollama id.
      think - The think text is empty for off, true for on, or another word for a level.

    • applyConsoleTarget

      public void applyConsoleTarget(String body)
      The applyConsoleTarget method stores one shell_model_set: body. A missing provider is handled as the Ollama frame. An empty Ollama id does not clear modelName. A Grok id is stored separately and never becomes that Ollama name. Effort sending changes only for true or false. Stream is true only for the text true. A blank, infinite, or unparsable temperature stays unset. A max-token value below 1 or not an integer stays unset. The console model file is written.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the stripped frame, including the command line.

    • applyConsoleMood

      public void applyConsoleMood(String text)
      The applyConsoleMood method stores or clears the console mood line. consoleMoodLine(String) reads the text. A result of null is ignored. The screen is not written.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the stripped message body.

    • sessionTokenReply

      public String sessionTokenReply()
      The sessionTokenReply method builds the stored-session count reply. A chat with no messages uses 1 token, 0 characters, and 0 blocks. A chat with messages sums the token count, the character count, and the block count. Empty message text counts as empty. The screen is not written.
      Returns:
      The return value is the session_tokens_result: body.

    • sessionExportReply

      public static String sessionExportReply(String toon)
      The sessionExportReply method wraps one message table in a reply. A null or empty table becomes messages[0]{r,ts,tok,x}: and a newline. A body that does not fit one frame returns export failed: the session does not fit in one frame.
      Parameters:
      toon - The table is the message table, or empty.
      Returns:
      The return value is the reply text.

    • applySessionReplace

      public String applySessionReplace(String text)
      The applySessionReplace method replaces this connection's turns with the user and assistant rows in the table. A missing command, a table that does not parse, or a role other than user or assistant leaves the stored turns as they stand. A failed replace does the same. The screen is not written. The configured prompt stays. The console mood leaves with the turns.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the stripped body, the command line plus the table.
      Returns:
      The return value is the reply text.

    • replaceResult

      public static String replaceResult(boolean ok, String reason)
      The replaceResult method builds the reply for one session replace. Success returns session_replace_result: and ok. Failure returns replace failed: plus the reason. A null reason is written as empty.
      Parameters:
      ok - The flag is true when the stored turns were replaced.
      reason - The reason is the short failure. It is unused when ok is true.
      Returns:
      The return value is the reply text.

    • consoleModelBody

      public String consoleModelBody()
      The consoleModelBody method echoes the console target, one line per field. Temperature and max tokens are omitted when they were absent. A null family is written as ollama.
      Returns:
      The return value is the result body after shell_model_result:.

    • consoleTargetLabel

      public String consoleTargetLabel()
      The consoleTargetLabel method returns the model line for the screen. Pool returns pool. Grok returns grok/ plus the Grok id. Any other family returns the stored Ollama id. A null Ollama id returns an empty string.
      Returns:
      The return value is the model line.

    • selectConsoleFamily

      public boolean selectConsoleFamily(String family)
      The selectConsoleFamily method switches the console family to ollama, grok, or pool. The stored options for each family stay. An empty Grok id is filled by ensureGrokModel(). An unknown word writes nothing and returns false. A stored family writes model plus the target label and returns true.
